description: 河源市台衡顶尖称重设备有限公司成立于 2014 年 7 月。本页介绍企业沿革、称重设备制造业务和生产基地。
summary: Established in July 2014, Heyuan Taiheng Top Weighing Equipment Co., Ltd. introduces its history, manufacturing operations and production base.

description: 浏览公司正门、办公区、厂区、秤台加工与焊接车间实拍。
summary: See the entrance, offices, factory grounds and the workshops used to fabricate and weld scale platforms.

description: 查看画册收录的证书与荣誉图片，放大跨页可阅读证书细节。
summary: Inspect the certificates and honors reproduced in the company brochure. Open the full-size spread for details.

description: 资质展示续页，集中陈列企业证书和质量管理相关资料。
summary: Additional certificates and quality-related documentation from the company catalog.

description: 了解生产管理、加工设备、生产线及售后服务。售后服务热线为 4000-566-765。
summary: Review the production lines, machining equipment, manufacturing management and after-sales service. The service hotline is 4000-566-765.

zh: 出口分体式汽车衡与传感器
en: Split truck scales and load cells
description: SCS 系列提供 20、30、50、60、80、100、120 和 150 吨量程。查看型号对照、安装方式、应用场景与称重传感器参数。
summary: The SCS range offers 20, 30, 50, 60, 80, 100, 120 and 150 tonne capacities. Compare models, installation layouts, applications and load cell specifications.

description: 查看各类称重模块，以及读卡器、车牌识别设备、摄像装置与红绿灯的图片和参数。
summary: Compare weigh modules and vehicle access accessories, including card readers, license plate recognition devices, cameras and traffic lights.

zh: 称重仪表、打印机与小地磅
description: 对照仪表、打印机及小地磅的产品说明，查阅台面尺寸、量程及可选不锈钢材质。
summary: Review indicators and printers, then compare floor scale dimensions, capacities and optional stainless steel construction.

zh: 畜牧称重、料塔与屠宰轨道秤
en: Livestock scales, feed bins and rail scales
description: 介绍屠宰轨道秤、料塔称重系统及牲畜秤的适用场景，并展示设备及安装现场。
summary: Explore slaughterhouse rail scales, feed bin weighing systems and livestock scales, with equipment and installation photographs.

zh: 一卡通称重与装车管理系统
description: 按示意图了解车辆进场、自动称重、装料、复称和放行之间的衔接，以及散装和定量装料设备。
summary: Follow vehicles through entry, weighing, loading, check weighing and release. Diagrams show bulk cargo and quantitative loading arrangements.

description: 结合现场图片，了解无人值守地磅的系统组成、车辆过磅流程和管理功能。
summary: Review the components, vehicle weighing workflow and management functions of an unattended weighbridge, illustrated by a site installation.

description: 查阅无人值守系统的配套功能和布局示意，了解车辆识别、现场显示与通行控制设备之间的关系。
summary: Study the system layout and supporting functions, including vehicle identification, on-site displays and access controls.

zh: 皮带秤、叉车秤、轨道衡与反应釜称重
en: Belt, forklift, rail and reactor weighing
description: 浏览输送、搬运、轨道车辆和化工容器称重设备实拍，以及洗轮机和自助称重终端的现场应用。
summary: See weighing equipment for conveyors, material handling, rail vehicles and chemical reactors, alongside wheel washers and self-service weighing terminals.

zh: 智慧搅拌站与部分客户案例
en: Smart mixing plants and customer examples
description: 了解智慧搅拌站的系统功能和适用范围，查看企业画册列举的客户案例。
summary: Explore the smart mixing plant system, its functions and applications, followed by the customer examples listed in the company brochure.
